title: Does the 'Close Door' Button Do Anything?
topic: In many US lifts it's disabled in normal use: since 1990 disability rules require doors to stay open long enough; it works for firefighters with a key.
audience: Everyday phone/PC/internet/game/AI-chat users who have seen this themselves
whyCare: Proven 171K demand; our twist adds the firefighter key and the 'placebo button' idea.
